pool_selection: Best lossless compression in each algorithm/pretokenizer cell for Chinese, Japanese, medical English and code; no selection on training loss, transfer loss, runtime or a preferred merge-noise value.
existing_candidates: All26 saved/native published tokenizer files from the previous search; unsupported unmarked control strings are handled as unused controls, never words.
cohorts: Keep the three historical96-document panels as references. Additional cases use fixed larger held-out cohorts chosen before checkpoint curves, with document-cluster bootstrap for multiple passages from one source document.
inference: Assess transferred BPB, checkpoint-specific canonical BPB and transfer gap separately. A nonsignificant improvement is inconclusive; practical flattening requires paired slope confidence bounds within a declared margin. No claim of an irreversible optimization/capacity wall or RL effectiveness follows from a finite20k run.
